jobs.title: Survey Technician
jobs.description:
At MacKay, we believe great people are the foundation of our growth and success.

We are in an exciting phase of expansion, creating new opportunities for our employees to take on meaningful work, collaborate across disciplines, and build long-term careers. Whether your role is technical or part of our support services team, you play an important role in delivering high-quality work and helping our projects succeed.

MacKay is seeking a Survey Technician to join our survey team in Roseville, California. This office and field-based position assists Professional Land Surveyors in the preparation of supporting data for land survey projects and focuses on producing accurate, high-quality drawings and deliverables using AutoCAD Civil 3D.

You will have an opportunity to work closely with our multi-disciplined team of Professional Land Surveyors, Engineers, and Land Use Planners on land development projects that shape communities and support our clients’ vision.

Ready to make an impact? Let’s talk.

Key Responsibilities

Apply survey information and reduce field notes to layout and draft designs and drawings for projects.
Perform base mapping, overlay preparation, and work on storm sewer, sanitary sewer, water main, and street design projects, including review site plans, layouts and publication mockups.
Review and conduct field check data for compliance with jurisdictional codes, to ensure survey standards are met.
Work with close supervision to complete a variety of office or field work as assigned such as preparing data, charts, plots, maps, records and documents related to surveys.
Provide support to other departments, such as preparing computer-generated maps and exhibits.
Prepare and maintain accurate survey and engineering records in support of licensed staff.
Develop knowledge of federal, state, and local rules, laws, and regulations regarding survey.
Occasional field work, including out of town travel.

Qualifications

A minimum of 2 years’ experience in both field and office land surveying preferred.
Proficiency with Civil 3D required.
Experience with Trimble Business Center preferred.
Must be a highly motivated individual with strong attention to detail.

Why Join MacKay?

A people-first culture

At MacKay, we put people first. We are committed to creating an environment where employees can grow, contribute, and do their best work. We support well-being, encourage balance, and create space for people to succeed both professionally and personally.

Meaningful work and real impact

Our teams take on complex infrastructure and environmental challenges that support critical systems and shape the places where people live and work. Every role contributes to delivering that work and making it successful.

Growth and opportunity

We are in an exciting phase of growth, expanding across geographies, services, and markets. That growth creates opportunities for our employees to take on new challenges, build their careers, and contribute in new ways as the company evolves.

A strong and trusted foundation

Built on more than 50 years of experience, MacKay has developed a reputation for quality work, strong relationships, and dependable results. You’ll be part of a team with a solid foundation and a clear direction for the future.

Opportunities to share in success

We provide opportunities for employees to participate in ownership and build long-term financial value as the company grows.

Our Values

At MacKay, our values guide how we work, collaborate, and support one another.

Honesty. We build trust through transparency, integrity, and accountability.
Dedication. We are committed to the success of our team members, clients, and communities.
Relationships. We foster lasting connections that strengthen our work and the teams around us.

Who We Are

MacKay is an infrastructure and environmental services firm built on more than 50 years of experience and a growing collective of expertise.

We are in an exciting phase of growth, expanding our reach, strengthening our capabilities, and bringing together talented teams across the country. That growth is creating new opportunities for our employees to take on meaningful work, collaborate across disciplines, and build long-term careers.

Every role at MacKay contributes to the success of our projects and the clients we serve. Whether your work is technical or operational, you are part of a team that delivers quality, builds relationships, and moves projects forward.

We’re looking for dedicated, talented individuals who deliver excellence, thrive in collaborative environments, and value both meaningful work and work-life balance. If this sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

Please note that the salary information shown below is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as various market and business considerations.

US Pay Range: $30 USD - $60 USD

Full-time employees receive a well-rounded benefit package including access to our company-sponsored Medical (including an HSA High Deductible option), Dental, Vision, FSA, and Supplemental Life Insurance plans. We also offer 100% company-paid Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability coverage. Employees are eligible to participate in our company's 401(k) plan with up to a 4% match. Additionally, employees receive paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, and are able to participate in employee ownership options. MacKay pays for expenses associated with licensure as well as annual performance bonuses.

Employment requires passing a pre-employment background check and drug screen.

As a federal contractor, we participate in E-Verify and are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

Open until filled.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Unitek Learning is a leading healthcare education organization focused on preparing the next generation of nurses and healthcare professionals.

Through its family of institutions, including Unitek College of Nursing, Eagle Gate College, Provo College, Brookline College, and Unitek EMT, Unitek delivers career-focused education designed to help students build meaningful careers while addressing critical workforce needs across the healthcare industry.

Through our Workforce Solutions segment, Unitek partners with hospitals and health systems to create sustainable talent pipelines and expand access to healthcare education through employer-based training and workforce development programs nationwide.

Job Description

The LVN program Coordinator works with and functions under the supervision of the Campus VN Program Director and VN Assistant Program Director for the Vocational Nursing Program.

Job Responsibilities include:

Assists with planning, developing, managing, updating and evaluating all aspects of the program.
Assists with preparing data and other written materials for all required state and Board requirements including reports, proposals, self-studies, surveys, audits, and site visits.
Assist in the training of new faculty and the professional development of existing faculty.
Assist in planning faculty staffing to ensure course coverage.
Ensures theory and clinical evaluations are completed in a timely manner by assigned faculty.
Assists in gathering evaluations from students, clinical sites. representatives, and faculty upon completion of each clinical rotation
Assist with strategic planning and assessment of instructional initiatives to ensure program quality.
Makes continuous efforts to improve quality of instruction.
Ensures clinical assignments, clinical rotation matrixes and calendars are completed in a timely manner.
Ensures faculty are consistently following policies and guidelines as related to student clinical rotation experience.
Reviews student learning material on an ongoing basis.
Ensures student records are maintained according to policies.
Submits required program reports and forms to the Program Director in a timely manner.
Keeps current with new technologies and safety regulations.
Provides advising support and planning assistance to potential and current students.
Ensures all students have completed the necessary documentation and meet the requirements for graduation and the state licensing exam.
Teach (either theory or clinical) half of the time as needed.
Other duties as assigned.
Pay Range: The annual pay range for this position is $104,000/year (minimum), and $110,000/year (maximum).*

Qualifications

Hold a valid, clear and current active license as a Vocational or Registered Nurse in assigned state.
Demonstrates effective problem-solving and leadership skills.
The ability to communicate pertinent information in a timely manner to appropriate personnel.
The ability to multi-task, set priorities, and meet deadlines.
Have a minimum of three years’ experience as a registered nurse or vocational nurse; one year shall be in teaching or clinical supervision, or a combination thereof.

Medical, Dental and Vision starting the 1st of the month following 30 days of employment
2 Weeks’ starting Vacation per year. Increasing based on years of service with company
12 paid Holidays and 2 Floating Holiday's

Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organization services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6,515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Job DescriptionThis role supports Federal Human Capital (HC) operations by delivering advanced workforce analytics, reporting, and data-driven insights. The specialist will extract, analyze, and translate HR data from multiple Federal systems into clear, executive-ready insights that inform workforce planning, hiring strategy, and organizational performance.
Key Job Duties
Support workforce analytics initiatives by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting Federal Human Resources (HR) data from systems such as NFC, HRConnect, and USA Staffing (USAS).
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports tracking key HR metrics (e.g., hiring timelines, attrition, workforce demographics, onboarding progress).
Build dynamic Excel, Power BI, or similar tools that allow real-time updates during executive briefings.
Provide recurring and ad hoc data analysis to support HR data calls, audits, and reporting requirements. Analyze the data and prove the outcome of the analysis.
Extract and normalize historical HR data from federal systems and portals (e.g., National Finance Center [NFC], HR Connect, USA Staffing, Enterprise Services Portal).
Track, collect, and develop datasets supporting HR audits, payroll reviews (A-123), and performance reporting.
Translate complex HR datasets into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations for senior leadership.
Convert technical HR terminology and Federal processes into plain-language insights for non-HR stakeholders.
Assist in end-to-end hiring analytics, including pipeline tracking, onboarding timelines, and process optimization; identify inefficiencies and recommend data-driven improvements.
Through data analytics, support continuous improvement initiatives aligned with agency HR and management goals.
Respond rapidly to changing requirements, priorities, and leadership requests.
Collaborate with HR teams, program offices, and leadership to refine analytics needs and deliverables.
Provide on-the-spot data adjustments and analysis during meetings with executives.
Job RequirementsMust be a US Citizen.
Must be able to obtain and maintain the government-required security clearance.
A minimum of 4 years of experience supporting Federal HR data calls, audits, and reporting requirements; and translating complex HR and workforce data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders.
Strong storytelling skills using data visualization and executive level presentations.
Knowledge of HC strategies and workforce analytics methodologies.
Understanding of Federal HR processes, including hiring, onboarding, personnel actions, and workforce planning.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft (MS) Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, data modeling) and SQL, queries, and formulas.
Experience building interactive dashboards (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
Strong data manipulation and analysis skills across large datasets to summarize numerical and quantifiable data to provide usable information.
Experience pulling large data sets for data calls, turning raw data into ratios, percentages, analytics for executive briefings; creating excel sheets where data can be searched.
Familiarity with Federal HR systems such as:NFC (National Finance Center)
HR Connect
USAS
Other Federal HR platforms
Experience smashing two data sets into a single data call response.
Experience utilizing AI, such as copilot, to do analytics and formulas is preferred.

jobs.title: Survey Field Technician
jobs.description:
Department:
Community Infrastructure
Location:
Jackson, MI

Description

Waggoner Engineering, Inc. is hiring a Survey Field Technician
for our Jackson, MS
office. The Survey Field Technician will work under the direction of the Party Chief, operating and maintaining survey equipment, collecting and downloading survey data, ensuring safety standards are maintained, and assisting the Party Chief as directed.

Your Primary Responsibilities will include

Assist Party Chief
: Support the Party Chief in daily survey operations.
Equipment Operation:
Operate and maintain survey equipment under the guidance of the Party Chief.
Safety Compliance
: Know, understand, and demonstrate safe operation of assigned equipment, and maintain safety standards.
Equipment Maintenance:
Keep equipment charged, clean, and in good working order.
Punctuality and Reliability
: Must be punctual and reliable in carrying out assigned duties.
Field Work:
Cut and clear brush along survey lines, drive rebar, stakes, hubs in the ground, and perform other field tasks as required.
Data Collection:
Collect data of existing features for various survey operations such as Boundary, Topographic, ALTA, Route surveys, etc.
Survey Procedures:
Have a working knowledge of proper survey procedures.
Other duties as assigned.

What you'll need

Experience:
Prior survey experience and/or specialized vocational training in survey technology preferred, but not required.
Technical Skills:
Proficiency with total station, robotic total station, RTK base rove GPS, VRS GPS, and levels, with preference given to experience with Trimble equipment.
Driving Record:
Must have an insurable driving record.
Physical Requirements:
Ability to perform moderately strenuous tasks, including lifting and carrying instruments weighing up to 75 pounds over rough terrain.
Availability:
Ability to work locally or out of town for extended periods.
Appearance:
Maintain a neat and clean appearance at all times.
Teamwork:
Ability to carry out instructions and tasks assigned by the Party Chief.

Why Join Our Team

We know work isn't only about what you do, it's also about who you work for and with! Waggoner Engineering provides a fun, family-friendly, and multicultural work environment that supports a work life balance, including:

WEI Incentive Program
Healthy Workplace Program
Employee Referral Bonus
Competitive Health Benefits
Career Development and Training
Flexible/Hybrid Schedule
Community Service Opportunities
Worldwide Travel Assistance

Waggoner Engineering, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.title: Health Data Analyst, DHHS
jobs.description:
FT / PT Status –
Full-Time Salary –
$20.28 - $36.85 Hourly Wage Remote Work / In-Office –
Hybrid Recruiter –
Niccole Johnson | niccolejohnson@utah.gov | 801-538-3956 Application Deadline –
7/12/2026

Key Responsibilities

The Utah Department of Health & Human Services
is seeking a data savvy individual to join Vital Records and Statistics (OVRS)
data team! This Health Data Analyst
will work to support Utah’s statewide vital records system by transforming complex data into high-quality, actionable information. The analyst will maintain and improve vital records databases, and collaborate with field staff, developers, cross department to ensure accurate, secure, and timely health data are available to support health decision-making, research, and policy.

The vision of the Division of Data System & Evaluation is to ensure Utah is a place where accurate, secure, and timely health data are available to improve health for all. OVRS administers Utah’s statewide system of vital records and statistics by documenting and certifying vital events-including births, deaths, adoptions, marriages,and divorces-reporting data to the National Vital Statistics System, and providing data to health programs, healthcare providers, researchers, educational institutions, businesses, and the public.

Manipulate, clean, validate, and combine large datasets across multiple years to standardize variable structures, coding schemes, and data formats.
Perform routine data quality assurance (QA/QC) by querying databases, identifying data issues and trends, generating quality control reports, and verifying that corrections have been implemented
Develop and maintain SAS, SQL, or other analytical programs to automate routine data processing, validation, and reporting tasks.

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

For this role, we are seeking data analysts with strong Python and SQL skills, a curiosity for how claims work and how our systems work them, the ability to communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, and the ability to both run independently and collaborate with our engineering and operations orgs. If you are ready to mold the vision for Reserv’s technology, join us on the journey.

What You Will Do

Work with our data stack: Python, Postgres, Looker, dbt, AWS, and Dagster
Develop and maintain our data model—generating new features, curating the semantic layer, and integrating new data sources—to build the trusted data asset that powers analytics, customer reporting, and the next generation of intelligent tools across Reserv
Help translate the core lifecycle of a claim into structured data and partner with the product ops team to incorporate low drag data collection into the claim lifecycle
Communicate ideas and specifications through detailed, precise writing

A proven ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences—including analysts, data engineers, and internal stakeholders—in a fast-paced environment.

Have a proven track record of shipping high quality data analysis at a high cadence.

401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
Environmental Project Scientist

Job Summary: 

Trileaf is seeking a full-time Environmental Project Scientist with 0-2 years of field experience conducting environmental due diligence work on telecommunications and commercial real estate projects, primarily including Phase I Environmental Site Assessments (Phase I ESAs), Phase II ESAs, National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Review Reports, and/or migratory bird evaluations and amongst other environmental assessment services. This position is based out of our remote Boston, Massachusetts office and travel includes all of the New England area.

Basic Responsibilities:

Phase I and II ESA responsibilities include conducting site visits of wireless communications facilities and commercial properties, reviewing historical records, environmental and regulatory databases, followed by the interpretation of the compiled information and the drafting of a standardized report in accordance with ASTM E-1527-21 (AAI). 

NEPA responsibilities include conducting site visits of proposed wireless communications facilities. Prior to conducting the site visit, a preliminary screening of listed and/or proposed threatened or endangered species, critical habitat, National Wetland Inventory Maps (NWI), Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Flood Insurance Rate Maps (FIRM) etc., as well as correspondence with Tribal, federal, state, and local agencies in accordance with FCC Rules Title 47 of the Code of Federal Regulations, Part 1, Subpart I, rule sections 1.1301 to 1.1319. Subsequent to these activities, an individual must be able to interpret the complied information and prepare a template NEPA report.

Migratory bird evaluations include ground-based field investigations for migratory bird surveys and any necessary permitting with state/local agencies.

Key Responsibilities:

Travel to project location, take detailed notes and photographs of site (2-4 days per week). Conducting interviews, analyzing government database records, performing regulatory agency file reviews; reviewing historical data (including topographic maps, Sanborn fire insurance maps, city directories, and aerial photographs); drafting a standardized report using information from these various sources. Perform QA/QC to the satisfaction of both management and clients and completing requested revisions & submitting report within pre-established timelines. Applicant will also conduct field work to collect samples of potentially contaminated subsurface media (soil, groundwater, and soil vapor) and/or indoor air and then compare analytical contaminant data collected to applicable regulatory standards.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Exploration Geologist – New Ventures
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Continental Resources is seeking a Senior Staff New Ventures Geoscientist to evaluate new venture opportunities, develop new play concepts, and support our commercially focused exploration strategy through integrated subsurface interpretation and analysis.

You will integrate regional geology with well data (logs, core, cuttings, and production where available), geophysics, and applied conventional and unconventional petrophysics to build play evaluations, generate prospects, and design testing programs that de-risk opportunities and support investment decisions.

Work products are used closely with Land and Business Development to support entry strategy, acreage capture, and deal decisions. The work is fast-paced and team-based, with tight timelines and frequent decision points. In this Senior Staff role, you provide technical leadership on key evaluations and mentor developing geoscientists through fit-for-purpose, integrated workflows.

Duties And Responsibilities

Lead prospect generation, evaluation, and maturation of new venture opportunities using integrated geological analysis, well log interpretation, applied petrophysics, geochemistry, and geophysical mapping to define play fairways and prospect risk.
Develop basin-to-prospect interpretations by integrating stratigraphic/structural frameworks with well data (logs, core, cuttings) and 2D/3D seismic mapping to constrain structure, stratigraphy, thickness trends, and fairway geometry.
Integrate conventional and unconventional petrophysics (core–log relationships, pay definition, fluid/rock effects, and rock property trends) into mapping, volumetrics, and uncertainty framing; ensure interpretations are consistent across wells, seismic, and analogs.
Develop integrated subsurface models and risk assessments that link tectono-stratigraphic evolution, charge and migration, reservoir and seal effectiveness, and trap timing, document assumptions, key uncertainties, and value drivers.
Partner with Land and Business Development to deliver clear, decision-ready evaluations that inform entry strategy, acreage capture, and deal decisions.
Provide technical input to exploration well planning (log suites, coring, testing, and sampling plans) and subsurface data strategies (seismic acquisition/reprocessing and mapping workflows as needed); capture post-drill learnings to improve prospect ranking.
Mentor developing geoscientists through technical coaching, peer reviews, and sharing best practices for integrated interpretation, uncertainty tracking, and concise technical communication.
Stay current on emerging exploration technologies and contribute to external technical engagements with partners and service providers as needed.
Other duties as assigned.

Skills And Competencies

Integrated Interpretation – Integrates geology, geophysics, petrophysics, and geochemistry into clear play and prospect models.
Geological Analysis – Advanced stratigraphic and structural interpretation; translates regional context into testable play and prospect concepts.
Well Log Interpretation & Petrophysics – Interprets open-hole logs and integrates core/cuttings and production with applied conventional and unconventional petrophysics.
Applied Geophysical Mapping – Proficient 2D/3D seismic structural and stratigraphic mapping.
Petroleum Systems & Play Risking – Applied knowledge of source rock, charge/migration, timing, trap/seal, and scenario-based risking.
Reservoir Characterization – Rock properties, petrophysics, and analogs to assess reservoir quality and distribution in conventional and unconventional settings.
Communication & Leadership – Clear, concise technical communication for senior technical audiences; effective facilitation of peer reviews and decision forums.
Collaboration – Works well across disciplines and turns inputs into recommendations.

Required Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Geoscience or Earth Sciences from an accredited university (Ph.D. a plus).
Minimum of ten (10) years of exploration experience with demonstrated success in new ventures and/or play evaluation, prospect generation, and subsurface risk assessment.
Expertise in conventional and unconventional reservoirs, including play fairway mapping, prospect generation, and probabilistic resource assessments.
Proficiency in industry-standard geoscience software (e.g., Geographix, Petrel, Kingdom, ArcGIS, PaleoScan, etc.).
Strong capability in geological interpretation, well log analysis, and applied integration of conventional and unconventional petrophysical data.
Experience supporting exploration well planning and execution and performing post-drill technical evaluation and lessons-learned capture.
Understanding of and exposure to economic evaluation, value drivers, and risk-based framing to support exploration screening and deal decisions.
An acceptable pre-employment background and drug test.

Preferred Qualifications

International and/or new ventures exploration experience, including prospect maturation and exploration & appraisal program support.
Experience applying remote sensing, surface imaging, or geospatial datasets as a complementary input to basin screening and integrated exploration workflows.
Awareness of, and experience applying, AI-assisted workflows and emerging technologies to improve interpretation efficiency, and general AI literacy.
Demonstrated ability to integrate structural geology, tectonic evolution, and basin-scale geodynamic frameworks into exploration strategies.
Curious, keeps learning, and looks for better ways to evaluate plays and prospects.
Positive, practical, and collaborative in high-uncertainty exploration work.
Quantitative Interpretation - Exposure to rock physics/AVO and seismic inversion concepts.
Professional proficiency in one or more languages in addition to English.
Experience working with partners in international, JV, or PSC settings, including technical assurance and stakeholder communication.

Physical Requirements And Working Conditions

Requires prolonged sitting, some bending and stooping.
Occasional lifting up to 25 pounds.
Manual dexterity sufficient to operate a computer keyboard and calculator.

We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.

Job Description

The Senior Enterprise Master Data Analyst will support the integrity, quality, and alignment of master data across ERP and WMS systems. This role focuses on data validation, issue investigation, analytics, and ongoing monitoring to prevent defects and maintain stable operations. The Analyst partners with DC teams, Business Units, IT, and Master Data Owners to ensure BD’s product and UOM data remains accurate, synchronized, and compliant with enterprise standards.

Key Responsibilities

Master Multi-System Validation: Become the expert who ensures perfect harmony between SAP, JDE, and WMS platforms by meticulously validating critical data elements including units of measure, item attributes, packaging specifications, and complex configuration dependencies.
Solve Data Mysteries: Channel your inner detective to identify patterns in recurring master data issues, conduct thorough root cause analysis, and strategically escalate systemic problems to the right business or technical stakeholders for permanent resolution.
Champion Data Governance: Apply and enforce robust data standards and governance protocols that ensure consistency and reliability across all integrated systems.
Build the Knowledge Base: Help create and maintain comprehensive documentation covering field definitions, integration rules, and approved mapping structures that serve as the foundation for organizational data intelligence.
Create Visual Intelligence: Design and maintain intuitive data quality dashboards that instantly highlight mismatches, unit of measurement conflicts, and integration errors, making complex data relationships visible and actionable.
Guard Against Data Drift: Implement vigilant monitoring systems to catch system sync exceptions, configuration anomalies, and subtle data drift before they impact operations.
Drive Insights Through Analytics: Leverage your expertise in SQL, Power BI, and Excel to transform raw data into compelling analytical insights that support strategic decision-making and proactive risk mitigation.
Prevent Operational Disruptions: Develop innovative, repeatable validation checks that identify potential operational risks before they can impact our distribution center network.
Build Cross-Functional Partnerships: Collaborate seamlessly with DC Operations, MDOs, Business Unit teams, IT specialists, and governance councils to resolve complex data discrepancies and continuously improve data management processes.
Ensure Smooth System Transitions: Play a critical role in testing cycles (SIT/UAT) and cutover activities by meticulously preparing and validating master data to ensure flawless system implementations.

Job DescriptionThis role supports Federal Human Capital (HC) operations by delivering advanced workforce analytics, reporting, and data-driven insights. The specialist will extract, analyze, and translate HR data from multiple Federal systems into clear, executive-ready insights that inform workforce planning, hiring strategy, and organizational performance.
Key Job Duties
Support workforce analytics initiatives by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting Federal Human Resources (HR) data from systems such as NFC, HRConnect, and USA Staffing (USAS).
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports tracking key HR metrics (e.g., hiring timelines, attrition, workforce demographics, onboarding progress).
Build dynamic Excel, Power BI, or similar tools that allow real-time updates during executive briefings.
Provide recurring and ad hoc data analysis to support HR data calls, audits, and reporting requirements. Analyze the data and prove the outcome of the analysis.
Extract and normalize historical HR data from federal systems and portals (e.g., National Finance Center [NFC], HR Connect, USA Staffing, Enterprise Services Portal).
Track, collect, and develop datasets supporting HR audits, payroll reviews (A-123), and performance reporting.
Translate complex HR datasets into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations for senior leadership.
Convert technical HR terminology and Federal processes into plain-language insights for non-HR stakeholders.
Assist in end-to-end hiring analytics, including pipeline tracking, onboarding timelines, and process optimization; identify inefficiencies and recommend data-driven improvements.
Through data analytics, support continuous improvement initiatives aligned with agency HR and management goals.
Respond rapidly to changing requirements, priorities, and leadership requests.
Collaborate with HR teams, program offices, and leadership to refine analytics needs and deliverables.
Provide on-the-spot data adjustments and analysis during meetings with executives.
Job RequirementsMust be a US Citizen.
Must be able to obtain and maintain the government-required security clearance.
A minimum of 4 years of experience supporting Federal HR data calls, audits, and reporting requirements; and translating complex HR and workforce data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders.
Strong storytelling skills using data visualization and executive level presentations.
Knowledge of HC strategies and workforce analytics methodologies.
Understanding of Federal HR processes, including hiring, onboarding, personnel actions, and workforce planning.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft (MS) Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, data modeling) and SQL, queries, and formulas.
Experience building interactive dashboards (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
Strong data manipulation and analysis skills across large datasets to summarize numerical and quantifiable data to provide usable information.
Experience pulling large data sets for data calls, turning raw data into ratios, percentages, analytics for executive briefings; creating excel sheets where data can be searched.
Familiarity with Federal HR systems such as:NFC (National Finance Center)
HR Connect
USAS
Other Federal HR platforms
Experience smashing two data sets into a single data call response.
Experience utilizing AI, such as copilot, to do analytics and formulas is preferred.

Under the direction of the Director and Assistant Director, the Athletics Program Coordinator is responsible for planning, organizing, implementing, supervising, and evaluating assigned youth and adult sports leagues, tournaments, community recreation programs, special events, and outdoor recreation activities. This position provides leadership for assigned programs, supervises seasonal staff and volunteers, recruits and supports volunteer coaches, and works collaboratively with department leadership to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality recreation opportunities for the community. Program Administration

Work with the Director and Assistant Director to develop and enforce department policies and procedures.
Assist in identifying and managing program risk and liability concerns.
Ensure programs operate in accordance with established safety standards and best practices.
Respond appropriately to emergencies and complete required incident documentation.

Assists with community recreation and special events as assigned.
Perform other duties as assigned.

The Athletics Program Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned programs and events from concept through completion. Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organization services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6,515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Job DescriptionThis role supports Federal Human Capital (HC) operations by delivering advanced workforce analytics, reporting, and data-driven insights. The specialist will extract, analyze, and translate HR data from multiple Federal systems into clear, executive-ready insights that inform workforce planning, hiring strategy, and organizational performance.
Key Job Duties
Support workforce analytics initiatives by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting Federal Human Resources (HR) data from systems such as NFC, HRConnect, and USA Staffing (USAS).
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports tracking key HR metrics (e.g., hiring timelines, attrition, workforce demographics, onboarding progress).
Build dynamic Excel, Power BI, or similar tools that allow real-time updates during executive briefings.
Provide recurring and ad hoc data analysis to support HR data calls, audits, and reporting requirements. Analyze the data and prove the outcome of the analysis.
Extract and normalize historical HR data from federal systems and portals (e.g., National Finance Center [NFC], HR Connect, USA Staffing, Enterprise Services Portal).
Track, collect, and develop datasets supporting HR audits, payroll reviews (A-123), and performance reporting.
Translate complex HR datasets into clear, concise, and visually compelling presentations for senior leadership.
Convert technical HR terminology and Federal processes into plain-language insights for non-HR stakeholders.
Assist in end-to-end hiring analytics, including pipeline tracking, onboarding timelines, and process optimization; identify inefficiencies and recommend data-driven improvements.
Through data analytics, support continuous improvement initiatives aligned with agency HR and management goals.
Respond rapidly to changing requirements, priorities, and leadership requests.
Collaborate with HR teams, program offices, and leadership to refine analytics needs and deliverables.
Provide on-the-spot data adjustments and analysis during meetings with executives.
Job RequirementsMust be a US Citizen.
Must be able to obtain and maintain the government-required security clearance.
A minimum of 4 years of experience supporting Federal HR data calls, audits, and reporting requirements; and translating complex HR and workforce data into clear, actionable insights for senior leaders.
Strong storytelling skills using data visualization and executive level presentations.
Knowledge of HC strategies and workforce analytics methodologies.
Understanding of Federal HR processes, including hiring, onboarding, personnel actions, and workforce planning.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft (MS) Excel (pivot tables, advanced formulas, data modeling) and SQL, queries, and formulas.
Experience building interactive dashboards (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
Strong data manipulation and analysis skills across large datasets to summarize numerical and quantifiable data to provide usable information.
Experience pulling large data sets for data calls, turning raw data into ratios, percentages, analytics for executive briefings; creating excel sheets where data can be searched.
Familiarity with Federal HR systems such as:NFC (National Finance Center)
HR Connect
USAS
Other Federal HR platforms
Experience smashing two data sets into a single data call response.
Experience utilizing AI, such as copilot, to do analytics and formulas is preferred.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

Continental Resources is seeking a Senior Staff New Ventures Geoscientist to evaluate new venture opportunities, develop new play concepts, and support our commercially focused exploration strategy through integrated subsurface interpretation and analysis.

You will integrate regional geology with well data (logs, core, cuttings, and production where available), geophysics, and applied conventional and unconventional petrophysics to build play evaluations, generate prospects, and design testing programs that de-risk opportunities and support investment decisions.

Work products are used closely with Land and Business Development to support entry strategy, acreage capture, and deal decisions. The work is fast-paced and team-based, with tight timelines and frequent decision points. In this Senior Staff role, you provide technical leadership on key evaluations and mentor developing geoscientists through fit-for-purpose, integrated workflows.

Duties And Responsibilities

Lead prospect generation, evaluation, and maturation of new venture opportunities using integrated geological analysis, well log interpretation, applied petrophysics, geochemistry, and geophysical mapping to define play fairways and prospect risk.
Develop basin-to-prospect interpretations by integrating stratigraphic/structural frameworks with well data (logs, core, cuttings) and 2D/3D seismic mapping to constrain structure, stratigraphy, thickness trends, and fairway geometry.
Integrate conventional and unconventional petrophysics (core–log relationships, pay definition, fluid/rock effects, and rock property trends) into mapping, volumetrics, and uncertainty framing; ensure interpretations are consistent across wells, seismic, and analogs.
Develop integrated subsurface models and risk assessments that link tectono-stratigraphic evolution, charge and migration, reservoir and seal effectiveness, and trap timing, document assumptions, key uncertainties, and value drivers.
Partner with Land and Business Development to deliver clear, decision-ready evaluations that inform entry strategy, acreage capture, and deal decisions.
Provide technical input to exploration well planning (log suites, coring, testing, and sampling plans) and subsurface data strategies (seismic acquisition/reprocessing and mapping workflows as needed); capture post-drill learnings to improve prospect ranking.
Mentor developing geoscientists through technical coaching, peer reviews, and sharing best practices for integrated interpretation, uncertainty tracking, and concise technical communication.
Stay current on emerging exploration technologies and contribute to external technical engagements with partners and service providers as needed.
Other duties as assigned.

Skills And Competencies

Integrated Interpretation – Integrates geology, geophysics, petrophysics, and geochemistry into clear play and prospect models.
Geological Analysis – Advanced stratigraphic and structural interpretation; translates regional context into testable play and prospect concepts.
Well Log Interpretation & Petrophysics – Interprets open-hole logs and integrates core/cuttings and production with applied conventional and unconventional petrophysics.
Applied Geophysical Mapping – Proficient 2D/3D seismic structural and stratigraphic mapping.
Petroleum Systems & Play Risking – Applied knowledge of source rock, charge/migration, timing, trap/seal, and scenario-based risking.
Reservoir Characterization – Rock properties, petrophysics, and analogs to assess reservoir quality and distribution in conventional and unconventional settings.

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. The Senior Enterprise Master Data Analyst will support the integrity, quality, and alignment of master data across ERP and WMS systems. new_jobs.title: Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Clinton Township, MI | Reports to Logistics & Procurement Manager | Facility Scope

Build. Lead. Transform.

If you thrive in the details and the big picture, this role is for you.

Quickparts is hiring a Project Coordinator
to serve as a critical link between production and support functions within our Clinton facility. This role is responsible for coordinating job execution, ensuring accurate communication across departments, and supporting on-time delivery through proactive planning, material coordination, and schedule alignment in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Why This Role Matters

The Project Coordinator is critical to our operational continuity and production success. In this role, you will:

✔ Serve as the primary communication hub for the Clinton facility

✔ Drive alignment across molding, tooling, engineering, scheduling, and quality

✔ Protect on-time delivery by proactively identifying and escalating project risks

✔ Ensure all departments are aligned on production priorities and schedule changes

✔ Maintain the accuracy of critical job documentation and system workflows

What You’ll Do

Serve as the primary communication hub for the Clinton facility, ensuring clear, timely, and accurate information flow between molding, tooling, design/engineering, scheduling, quality, materials, purchasing, and shipping.
Ensure all departments are aligned on production priorities, customer requirements, and schedule changes.
Own daily production status reporting by attending production meetings and delivering accurate, actionable updates on job status and risks.
Review, validate, and release work orders for accuracy and completeness, ensuring alignment with workflows and documentation standards.
Maintain accurate job travelers, production folders, and traceability documentation.
Drive alignment with production scheduling by ensuring all job-critical information is accurate and reflected in the production plan.
Coordinate material readiness with purchasing and materials teams, ensuring timely procurement of resins, colorants, additives, and inserts.
Actively monitor project and production status, identifying and escalating risks such as material shortages, tooling delays, capacity constraints, and scheduling conflicts.
Support operational continuity by providing backup coverage across scheduling, materials, inventory control, shipping/receiving, and purchasing during peak demand or plant disruptions.
Develop accurate rerun part quotes, utilizing current material costs, cycle times, and machine rates.
Observe all safety standards, wear required personal protective equipment, and adhere to the Company’s Code of Conduct.

What We’re Looking For

High school diploma or equivalent required; post-secondary education desired.
Experience in injection molding, plastics manufacturing, or similar production environment preferred.
Strong understanding of ERP/MES systems and production workflows.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with excellent planning and organizational skills.
Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent customer support service, verbal and written communication, and interpersonal skills.
Proficient computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office products; experience with CAD a plus.
A proven history of excellent attendance, including flexibility to support extended or quarter-driven hours based on business needs.
Ability to work in both office and light manufacturing environments, including sitting at a workstation, reaching, bending, and occasionally lifting light to moderate-weight items.

Why You’ll Love It Here

Real ownership — your work shapes the company
High-growth, global organization
Complex technical challenges
Strong culture of accountability and collaboration
Flexible work environment
Competitive compensation
401K Employer match
Excellent health and wellness benefits
Generous Paid Time Off - Recharge with ample PTO, including vacation days, sick leave, and holidays

Celebrate Your Strengths!

Requirements

We believe that understanding your natural behavioral style helps ensure success for both you and Quickparts. As part of our application process, we invite you to complete a quick, six‑minute Behavioral Assessment. This brief assessment highlights your unique strengths and how they align with our role requirements—providing valuable insights to spark great conversations about your fit, growth, and development here at Quickparts. Please click the link below to begin the assessment:

Quickparts Assessment Link

About Quickparts

Quickparts is a global leader in on-demand manufacturing with over 25 years of experience. We deliver advanced manufacturing solutions including metal & plastic 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, and casting patterns.

With facilities across the US and Europe and more than 4,000 customers worldwide, we serve industries including aerospace, defense, automotive, medical, energy, and industrial equipment.

Our team of application engineers and project managers average 10+ years of experience — ensuring customers receive expert guidance from prototype to production.

Quickparts is ISO 9001 certified and ITAR registered, and we are continuously expanding our quality capabilities to support regulated industries.

new_jobs.title: Part-time Behavioral Health Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Basic Function Of Position

The Behavioral Health Coordinator provides administrative, scheduling, referral, and care coordination support for the Behavioral Health and Wellness Program within UFA. Working under the direction of the Health and Safety Battalion Chief, the position serves as a central point of contact for behavioral health resource requests, assists with program eligibility and utilization tracking, coordinates referrals and follow-up activities, and supports the overall administration of the program through budget management, records management, and general office support.

Supervision Received

The Behavioral Health Coordinator works with minimal supervision, under the direction of the Health and Safety Battalion Chief and the Health and Wellness Officer.

Supervision Exercised

None

Principal Responsibilities

Receives and coordinates incoming requests for behavioral health and wellness resources from employees, retirees, family members, and other individuals seeking assistance; assists individuals in navigating available services and facilitates referrals to appropriate resources, including the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Behavioral Health and Wellness Officer, peer support team, external clinicians, insurance-based providers, and community resources.
Works in collaboration with the Health and Wellness Officer and Health and Safety Battalion Chief to verify program eligibility, coordinate authorizations, track utilization, and ensure behavioral health resources are provided in accordance with UFA policy, program guidelines, and applicable laws.
Manage scheduling and program coordination for individuals utilizing Behavioral Health and Wellness Program services; maintain referral and treatment tracking systems, assist with follow-up communications, and support coordination between participants, clinicians, and program staff.
Proactively coordinates meetings and schedules, ensuring supporting documents are received and accessible.
Prepares a wide variety of correspondence and reports for the Behavioral Health Program; reviews incoming correspondence and initiates replies as appropriate; routes matters requiring action by staff or other clinicians and follows up to ensure actions are complete.
Seeks out grant opportunities to support the Behavioral Health Program; completes grant applications and monitors compliance with grants awarded.
Coordinates travel of Behavioral Health employees in collaboration with UFA's Travel Coordinator and in compliance with UFA travel policy
Performs computer work related to word processing, spreadsheets, databases, and other computer programs.
Performs basic financial functions such as purchasing, billing, collection, and reconciliation of bank statements.
Maintains files for correspondence, records, reports, and other documents.
Oversees and coordinates all record keeping regarding peer support meetings, trainings, and callbacks.
Assists the Health and Safety Battalion Chief in planning, administering, managing, and tracking the Behavioral Health budget. Is primarily responsible for generating and tracking material request forms. Maintains a running ledger of expenditures made. Reconciles the budget balances with UFA Finance Division periodic budget reports.
Solicits and evaluates new and existing vendors for quality, responsiveness, and efficiency; seeks competitive pricing from various vendors or clinicians as needed.
Performs other duties of a similar nature or level.

Typical Decisions

Exercises considerable independent judgment in performing tasks requiring advanced office skills.
Uses knowledge of pertinent rules, policies, and procedures in the organization to perform tasks that may require in-depth research to complete
Sets priorities within assigned functions, relying on demonstrated experience and in-depth knowledge of billing procedure and program perations.

Minimum Requirements

High school graduate or equivalent
Valid Driver's License
Two years of general office support experience, billing experience or a combination of related education (Business Management, Public Administration, Social Work, or Psychiatric-related fields) and experience

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Knowledge and Skills:

Strong written and oral communication skills; flexible ability to learn and consistently interpret complex regulations; and solid personal organization and workload management skills.
Familiar with common psychiatric or behavioral health and wellness resources and capabilities
Working knowledge of basic budgeting, grant application processes, grant management processes, record keeping, and records storage practices.
Standard office procedures as well as standard business etiquette and procedures. Knowledge of UFA and UFSA policies and procedures is expected.
Business English grammar and language rules, proper spelling, and general accounting rules, as well as knowledge of office record-keeping, report preparation, and office organization.
Extensive knowledge of software programs within the Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, and Internet Explorer, with the ability to learn other computer programs and technology efficiently and effectively as required.

Ability To

Operate all general office equipment, including copiers, printers, fax machines, digital cameras, and scanners.
Meet expected deadlines with little direct supervision, while using effective judgment in interpreting or adapting guidelines and protocols to specific cases or problems.
Promote a high-level of customer service and good public relations and demonstrate strong interpersonal skills with UFA employees, vendors, individuals from other affiliated organizations or the general public
Expand basic points of information and create correspondence, reports, and presentations.
Make decisions independently in accordance with established policies with only general instruction or guidance.
Learn new processes independently with a willingness to invest time to learn and create new systems and processes in order to increase effectiveness and efficiency in the long term.
Communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing, and to express ideas clearly.

Working Environment

Work is performed in a general office environment during routine office hours, Monday through Friday; however, after-hours and weekend work is possible. Work may include infrequent response to emergencies or behavioral health after action reviews to assist with logistical and/or administrative duties.

Physical And Mental Job Requirements

To perform the job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each of the essential job functions satisfactorily. This position involves periods of prolonged sitting and use of computer equipment. This position requires the physical and mental capabilities to read information printed on paper and displayed on computer monitors; hear, speak, and communicate verbally using the English language; cognitive thinking and mathematical calculation capabilities; manual dexterity to manipulate standard office equipment, papers, files, and records. This position requires occasional driving and the ability to lift up to ten (10) pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position is classified as a Category B position with regard to the Employee's Use of Mobile Ph

ones policy.

----------------------------------- --- -------------------------- -------------
Title:** **Athletics Program Coordinator** **Effective Date:** 07/2026

FSLA Status:** Non-Exempt **Benefited:** Yes
----------------------------------- --- -------------------------- -------------

Overall Responsibility

Under the direction of the Director and Assistant Director, the Athletics Program Coordinator is responsible for planning, organizing, implementing, supervising, and evaluating assigned youth and adult sports leagues, tournaments, community recreation programs, special events, and outdoor recreation activities. This position provides leadership for assigned programs, supervises seasonal staff and volunteers, recruits and supports volunteer coaches, and works collaboratively with department leadership to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality recreation opportunities for the community. The Athletic Program Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned programs from initial planning through post-program evaluation while continually seeking opportunities to improve operations, participation, customer service, and the overall participant experience.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Program Administration

Plan, organize, coordinate, implement, and evaluate assigned sports leagues, tournaments, camps, clinics, community recreation programs, outdoor recreation activities, and special events.
Develop seasonal schedules, registration timelines, game schedules, tournament brackets, and program calendars.
Evaluate program effectiveness and recommend improvements to increase participation and operational efficiency.
Monitor program participation and maintain accurate records and reports.
Assist with marketing and promotion of recreation programs through community outreach, social media, printed materials, and other communication efforts.

Staff Leadership

Recruit, interview, assist with hiring, train, schedule, supervise, mentor, and evaluate seasonal employees assigned to recreation programs.
Provide initial orientation and ongoing training for staff working in recreation programs.
Foster professionalism, teamwork, accountability, and excellent customer service among employees.
Help ensure County employees and seasonal staff adhere to department policies, procedures, and dress code requirements.

Volunteer and Community Relations

Recruit, coordinate, and support volunteer coaches for youth recreation programs.
Maintain regular communication with parents, coaches, participants, officials, volunteers, schools, and community partners.
Provide volunteer coaches with orientation, program expectations, and ongoing support.
Address participant concerns, resolve conflicts professionally, and promote a positive experience for all participants and spectators.

Facility and Event Operations

Coordinate facility usage and ensure recreation facilities are prepared and operational for scheduled activities.
Prepare athletic fields, courts, and recreation areas for practices, games, tournaments, and events. This may include operating department equipment.
Assist with cleaning, maintenance, and inspection of recreation facilities, athletic fields, and program equipment.
Report maintenance and safety concerns to department leadership or appropriate department contact.
Schedule officials and coordinate event staffing for athletic programs.

Budget and Administrative Support

Assist the Director and Assistant Director with developing and monitoring program budgets and financial reports as assigned.
Order equipment, uniforms, shirts, awards, and other program supplies.
Assist with office operations, participant registration, customer service, and other administrative duties as needed.
Maintain program records, reports, and documentation.

Safety and Risk Management

Work with the Director and Assistant Director to develop and enforce department policies and procedures.
Assist in identifying and managing program risk and liability concerns.
Ensure programs operate in accordance with established safety standards and best practices.
Respond appropriately to emergencies and complete required incident documentation.

Other Duties

Assists with community recreation and special events as assigned.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Expected Leadership

The Athletics Program Coordinator is expected to take ownership of assigned programs and events from concept through completion. This includes identifying operational needs, anticipating challenges, proposing solutions, managing assigned resources responsibly, and continually improving the quality and efficiency of department programs. This position is expected to build strong relationships with participants, parents, coaches, volunteers, schools, community organizations, and staff. The successful candidate will serve as a visible, approachable, and professional representative of Carbon Events & Recreation Complex and Carbon County while fostering a positive, inclusive, and customer-focused recreation environment.

Knowledge, Skills And Attributes

Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills.
Knowledge of youth and adult sports leagues, tournaments, and community recreation programming.
Knowledge of athletic rules, safety standards, and risk management practices.
Ability to supervise, motivate, train, and evaluate employees and volunteers.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills.
Ability to effectively resolve conflicts and work with difficult situations in a professional manner.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Basic computer skills.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
Ability to learn department software, registration systems, scheduling software, and operational procedures.
Knowledge of athletic field preparation, facility operations, and recreation equipment is preferred.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities and perform a variety of tasks in a fast-paced environment.

Oversee and coordinate senior activities and programs including personal care, recreation and fitness, nutrition and meal distribution, senior information and referral services, family caregiver support services and inter-generational activities, programs and events; may oversee and coordinate youth programs at Multigenerational Center.
Recommend and assist in the implementation of program goals and objectives; establish schedules and methods for providing services; implement policies and procedures.

Schedule usage of facilities for activities including social, cultural, and recreational functions; provide information and assistance to users of facilities.
Maintain records and develop reports concerning new or ongoing programs and program effectiveness; maintain records for senior programs and volunteers; maintain and file various senior affairs reports; prepare statistical reports and maintain program databases as required.

social services
community services
physical fitness
recreation; and
